The '''[[Yacht/Legends|yacht]]''' of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] leader [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] was a large, stealth [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Xizor used the vessel to attack the [[holostar]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|agent]] [[Javul Charn]] while she was aboard the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] near [[Mimban/Legends|Circarpous V]].
